subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The reviewer shall cite, on every severity assignment, a row of a versioned calibration table maintained as reviewed data; a finding whose severity contradicts its cited row shall be structurally invalid.
rationale: calibration as data — the anti-nitpick dial, auditable
fit_criterion: schema validation enforces the citation; a contradiction fixture fails validation; the calibration file changes only via PR (history inspection)
